title: Concept: Async subprocess started through a shell in python — review required
description: In python, the shell variant of the async subprocess API is used. The name of the function states the property that makes it dangerous: the command is handed to a shell. Async code often builds the string from a request payload in the same coroutine that awaits the result.
applicability: python async services that call external programs.
risk: Shell injection with service privileges; HIGH severity.
